brief_en: Switzerland page consolidates infectious disease surveillance records from Switzerland FOPH IDD. It combines source metadata, time-series charts, and downloadable machine-readable datasets.
brief_zh: 瑞士页面整合来自瑞士 FOPH/BAG IDD 的传染病监测记录，包含来源信息、时间序列图表和可下载数据。
surveillance_system_en: The dataset is built from configured official feeds for Switzerland; current primary sources include Switzerland FOPH IDD.
surveillance_system_zh: 该数据集来自瑞士已配置的官方数据源；当前主要来源包括瑞士 FOPH/BAG IDD。
interpretation_en: Coverage currently spans 2013-01-01 to 2026-05-18 across 43 tracked diseases.
reporting_cadence_en: Source reporting frequency is inferred as WEEKLY; charts use weekly-equivalent normalization where applicable.
reporting_cadence_zh: 来源报告频率推断为 WEEKLY；相关图表在适用时使用周等价归一化。
limitations_en: Counts reflect reported surveillance records and may be affected by case definitions, reporting lag, source cadence, and missing population denominators.
limitations_zh: 病例数反映已报告的监测记录，可能受病例定义、报告延迟、来源频率和人口分母缺失影响。
